one_line: A composite heroine embodying the women traders and protest leaders of Imphal’s Ima Keithel from its early lallup-era markets to the Nupi Lan agitations.

appearance.age_look: Looks late 20s, lean but sturdy build, with the physical strength and endurance of a working market woman who also joins protests.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, strong jaw, lightly arched brows, and determined almond-shaped eyes; default expression is calm, focused vigilance that turns fierce when confronted with injustice.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair parted slightly off-center, oiled and combed smooth, pulled back into a low bun at the nape; a thin white cotton headscarf (pheijom-style) folded into a band hugs the hairline and ties at the back, keeping the bun neat.
appearance.costume: She wears an era-accurate Meitei market woman’s outfit: a handwoven phanek (wrap skirt) in muted maroon with narrow horizontal black and cream stripes, wrapped firmly from waist to ankle; over this a soft off-white cotton innaphi shawl with a subtle thin red border, wrapped over both shoulders and diagonally across the torso to keep her fully covered; beneath, a simple long-sleeved pale sky-blue blouse with a modest round neckline; her feet are in plain brown leather sandals suited for walking long distances; minimal jewellery includes a small pair of gold studs, a simple brass bangle on her right wrist, and a thin black thread necklace; the textiles look slightly worn but well cared for, suggesting daily market use and modest prosperity.
appearance.signature: A sturdy woven bamboo market basket with a flat base and loop handles, carried either in her left hand or strapped with a simple cloth sling, filled with covered rice, vegetables, and cloth bundles, with a rolled petition scroll tied to one handle as a symbol of the Nupi Lan protests.

ref_desc: A late-20s Meitei woman with an oval medium-brown face, straight black hair in a low bun under a thin white headscarf, wearing a maroon striped phanek, off-white innaphi shawl, pale sky-blue blouse and brown sandals, always carrying a bamboo market basket with a petition scroll tied to its handle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-20s Meitei woman representing the women of Ima Keithel: an oval-faced, medium-brown complexion heroine with determined almond eyes and straight black hair parted slightly off-center, oiled smooth into a low bun at the nape, held by a thin white cotton headscarf folded like a band around her hairline and tied at the back. She wears a handwoven maroon phanek wrap skirt with narrow black and cream horizontal stripes, wrapped securely from waist to ankle, a simple pale sky-blue long-sleeved blouse with a modest round neckline, and an off-white cotton innaphi shawl with a thin red border draped over both shoulders and diagonally across her torso so her upper body is fully and modestly covered. On her feet are plain brown leather sandals; her jewellery is minimal: small gold stud earrings, a single brass bangle on her right wrist, and a thin black thread necklace. Her build is lean but sturdy, posture upright and resolute, expression calm yet ready to turn fierce in protest. Her signature prop is a sturdy woven bamboo market basket with a flat base and loop handles, carried in her left hand or on a simple cloth sling, filled with covered rice and produce, with a rolled petition scroll visibly tied to one handle; use maroon, off-white, pale sky blue, black, and brown leather as the dominant colours and show her from front, side, and back to clearly present the consistent face, hair, costume, and basket details.
